descriptionHtml:
Candidate N17 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Generation is not on the server: the note is still written and saved by the page, so a reload, a closed tab or a killed phone page loses a note the model already wrote; no 'generating' state on return, a failure while away is never shown, and the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 15 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: 'use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only billing to the server. Confirmed on dev (TC-14/S07 reload: Haiku answered, no note saved).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S07, OAT-03/S15, TC-25/S14, TC-21/S28, TC-17/S27

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S26 Slow and failed generation while the physician is away: a generating state while the call runs, the note or an explicit failure on return (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician, two patients per mode as in S07. The runner controls the ai/notes:generateNote call: held about 15 s and then answered (cells H), or failed so that no model answers (cells F)

When Cell H, each mode: type the cell text, press Generate Note & Finish, open the second patient at once, return to the first within 2 s and open Post-Round; after the call is released, wait 5 s and look again. …

Then While the call is held, Post-Round shows a generating state, never only 'Complete the Encounter tab first' (UAT 3.5 and U4; OAT-03: the physician is never left waiting with nothing). After the release the note is there. When generation fails while the physician is away, on return an explicit failure shows and the dictation is on the Encounter tab

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint: the early checkpoint mustContainAny a generating marker ('Generating', 'Writing note') and mustNotContain 'Complete the Encounter tab first'; the late one carries the cell's blood pressure; the failure cells need an accepted failure string ('Note not generated', 'couldn’t be generated', 'could not be generated'; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev/newspec-c.

Slow and failed generation while the physician is away: a generating state while the call runs, the note or an explicit failure on return (both modes)

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Dataset gen-ac15 on dev (live Haiku). Hospital: back on the chart 3.7 s after the press while the note was still being written: Post-Round showed 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' and the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button, no generating state (FAILED); the note then appeared without a reload (passed; the page that started it was still alive). Nursing Home: the note (Haiku, 3.2 s) was already there when the physician came back at 4.3 s, so the generating state could not be observed (recorded); the note was on Post-Round (passed). The failure half (cell F) cannot be forced on dev (no fault injection); it is judged locally (failed). Timings recorded: notes.generateNote 4.0 s (Hospital) / 3.2 s (Nursing Home), providerMs within 6 ms of the total.

Product issue: Coming back to a chart whose note is still being written shows 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' instead of a generating state; the physician may press Generate again or think the dictation was lost.

Evidence: 1 attached; 4 not attached:

  • newspec-c/evidence/gen/gen-ac15/evidence/TC-14-S26-hospital-early.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/gen/gen-ac15/evidence/TC-14-S26-hospital-late.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/gen/gen-ac15/evidence/TC-14-S26-nursing-home-early.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
  • newspec-c/evidence/gen/gen-ac15/evidence/TC-14-S26-nursing-home-late.png — a dev screenshot, not attached

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-ai. This dev newspec-c result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local newspec-c] failed · product (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)) PW, local stack, both modes, generateNote mocked at the socket. Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach…
